title: Intentional Fragility
subtitle: Bayesian context decay & semantic rot in local-first LLM orchestration
body: The design argument under all of it: systems that degrade gracefully and signal their own decay beat brittle systems that fail silently. Formalizes context decay as a Bayesian process, names semantic rot as a distinct failure mode from forgetting, and argues for forgetting as an accountable, logged operation rather than an accident of window size.
